title: AWS re:Invent 2015 | (NET403) Another Day, Another Billion Packets
summary: Eric Brandwine's AWS re:Invent 2015 session on how Amazon VPC networking works. It covers the problems the design solved, why traditional approaches do not scale, and the mechanisms used for customer isolation and VPC endpoints.
why: Considered a favorite deep dive into how AWS does virtual networking at L3 and why VPC hosts cannot snoop each other.

quote.text: Here's the ever excellent Eric Brandwine explaining what AWS does at L3 wrt VPC
